stories.title: Analyzing the Chiefs' win over the Broncos
stories.summary: Making his Chiefs debut, Kenneth Walker III powered Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs past the Broncos.

stories.title: Walker stars in Chiefs debut, while scrambling Mahomes shows work 'paid off'
stories.summary: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes, making his return from a torn ACL, and running back Kenneth Walker III, making his Chiefs debut, powered Kansas City to a season-opening blowout win over Denver.

stories.title: Patriots' Kraft on Macklemore: Won't provide platform for 'hate speech'
stories.summary: Robert Kraft said he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due in part to a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."

stories.title: Sources: Brees mulled NFL comeback, playing for Broncos in AFC title game
stories.summary: Broncos assistant coaches had discussions with Drew Brees about the former star QB coming out of retirement to play for Denver in last season's AFC Championship Game, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: PGA Tour announces categories, points system for two new 2028 series
stories.summary: The PGA Tour on Tuesday announced membership categories and explains points system for its Championship and Challenger Series starting in 2028.
